description:
##Duration, Distance, Terrain
1.5 hours
1 mile at a moderate pace, stopping at various sites along the tour

##About
What do Sam Mayday Malone, a private-eye named Spenser, and Igloo the Fox Terrier have in common? They all know the Flat is where it's at!

Discover one of Boston's least known and most delightful neighborhoods with our knowledgeable guides.

Built on made land along the Charles River, the Flat is geologically part of Back Bay and culturally part of Beacon Hill, with the architecture of both.

Explore this intimate patch of real estate with charming residences and notable landmarks, including the Charles Street Meeting House, the Church of the Advent and the Sunflower Castle.

##Meeting location:
Meet your guide outside the Charles/MGH MBTA station on the Red Line.

Finding Your Guide: All guides carry an 8×11 sign that says “Boston By Foot Walking Tours.”

Nearest MBTA Station: Charles/MGH (Red Line)

##What to bring
Comfortable shoes, dress for the weather, water bottle
